options.description: The case remembers which session found it; when the fix lands, that session is told what was fixed and what to retry. Nothing waits; work blocked by the defect stays blocked until then.
options.label: Keep working, told when fixed (Recommended)

options.description: That one step (e.g. a merge check that held wrongly) stays refused in that session until the fix lands; the rest works. Literal 'unlock', but a new kind of hold, and it can wait on a fix that never lands.
options.label: Hold only the failed step

options.description: The session stops until the fix lands. Strongest, but blocks your work on plumb's own defect.
options.label: Hold the whole session

payload.question: 'Unlock the session that found the issue': today a plumb defect never holds a session. What should the session do while its fix is in progress?
